name: ApprovalCycleTimeAnalyzer
tagline: The Approval Cycle Time Analyzer shows how long approvals take and where they get stuck.
description: The Approval Cycle Time Analyzer shows how long approvals take and where they get stuck. It reads a list of approval steps - one row for each time a request reaches a stage such as Line manager, Budget holder, Finance review or CFO - and draws one time bar per request. Each coloured part of the bar is the time spent at one stage; grey parts are hand-off waits between stages; a striped part is a step that is still waiting and keeps growing until someone acts.
features: One stacked time bar per request (time at each stage plus hand-off waits, live ageing of open steps, target marker)
Stage and approver bottleneck views with median / P90 times
Status / group / over-target filters, grouping, sorting, drill-down
Multi-select with Nudge / Escalate / Open actions
A phone card layout and Power Fx outputs and events
